name: LaunchNotes
description:
Connect LaunchNotes and run your product communication in plain language — announcements, public roadmap, and customer feedback. Draft, publish, schedule, move, and measure, all from the conversation.

Query announcements, roadmap items, feedback, and engagement without switching apps. Turn shipped work into a draft, publish it now or schedule it for Tuesday, and attach the links that back it up. Move a roadmap item to Released and notify everyone following it — or post an internal-only update your team sees and customers don't. See your top performing updates along with feedback sentiment.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LaunchNotes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LaunchNotes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.launchnotes.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LaunchNotes MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LaunchNotes lists 29 MCP tools, including launchnotes_archive_announcement, launchnotes_create_announcement, launchnotes_create_external_content_link, launchnotes_create_work_item, launchnotes_get_announcement, launchnotes_get_feedback, launchnotes_get_project, launchnotes_get_project_analytics, launchnotes_get_top_announcements, launchnotes_get_work_item, launchnotes_list_announcements, and launchnotes_list_categories.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LaunchNotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LaunchNotes in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
LaunchNotes requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LaunchNotes is developed by LaunchNotes. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
